item.title: White House Warns Democrats, Biden Revisits 2024, Baby Buried Alive Rescued: AM Update 11/12 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
The White House warns congressional Democrats that their planned investigations into President Trump's administration could cross legal boundaries, potentially setting up a series of courtroom battles - Will Chamberlain of the Article III Project weighs in. Former President Joe Biden says he would have resigned had he known about his cancer diagnosis while in office, and downplays his disastrous 2024 debate performance. South Carolina authorities rescue an 11-month-old baby who was allegedly buried alive by his father and left underground for nearly 24 hours. Former Wisconsin Lieutenant Governor Mandela Barnes sues the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel for defamation, alleging a reporter with whom he previously had a sexual relationship helped develop a damaging story about his involvement with other women.
